murn_ember_spite.name: Murn Ember-Spite
murn_ember_spite.quote: You don't need a sword that glows for a thousand years. You need a blade that melts an ogre's face off right now.

nixie_flit.name: Nixie 'Ink-Fingers' Flit
nixie_flit.quote: Save your spell slots for when you're actually dying, darling.

gideon_and_brawn.name: Gideon Vane & Master Brawn
gideon_and_brawn.quote: The trick is diluting a brew meant for a storm giant so it doesn't melt a halfling's stomach lining.

keeva_copperpin.name: Keeva 'Sprocket-Wren' Copperpin
keeva_copperpin.quote: Give me two gears, a piston, and copper wire, and I'll solve whatever problem is trying to eat you.

barney_and_thrum.name: Barney Chubb & Lady Thrum
barney_and_thrum.quote: Keep the beer cold, the hearth warm, and never stand directly under a Cloud Giant when they sneeze.
